title: Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut to generate videos ~2× faster than…
content:
Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Mini in CapCut to generate videos ~2× faster than Seedance 2.0 Fast while using ~30% fewer credits for similar quality  
If you’re iterating on ads/social content or testing many concepts, switch to Seedance 2.0 Mini to save time and credits during multi-variant generation  
Use the Mini-720P option during the launch promo to spend 33% fewer credits per generation  
If you need CapCut Pro, buy during the promo (up to 60% off) to reduce overall Seedance workflow costs
